title: finding(fields): `MarkdownCellRenderer` / `HtmlCellRenderer` paint a childless container for `[]` — the objectui#8481 blank-cell defect, one renderer family over
body:
Found while implementing objectui#8490 by rendering **every registered field type** against `[]`, `{}`, `''` and `null` through `getCellRenderer` on `e411c3e58`. objectui#8490 is fenced to the renderers that **fabricate** a value for `[]`; objectui#8481 fixed three renderers whose output for `[]` was **blank**. This is the blank class again, in a renderer family neither card covered. DOM shapes are written in words rather than literally — tag-shaped fragments are eaten from GitHub bodies even inside backticks.

## Measured on `e411c3e58`

| field types | renderer | rendered for `[]` | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `markdown` | `MarkdownCellRenderer` | a SPAN classed `text-sm text-muted-foreground` with no text (the Suspense fallback of `String([])`, i.e. the empty string) | guard is `value == null \|\| value === ''`; `[]` passes, `String([])` is `''` |
| `html`, `richtext` | `HtmlCellRenderer` | a DIV classed `prose prose-sm …` with no children | same guard, same coercion |

Both guards live in `packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx`. Every other text-like type (`text`, `textarea`, `code`, `time`, `auto_number`) already answers `[]` with the shared `EmptyValue`, because `TextCellRenderer` tests the coerced text rather than the raw value.

Adjacent, measured in the same sweep: all three types render the literal text `[object Object]` for `{}` — `String({})` — where `TextCellRenderer`'s `coerceToSafeValue` answers `[Object]`. Grouped here because it is the same guard; split it out if that is cleaner to triage.

## Why it is not in objectui#8490

objectui#8490's fence is the renderers that draw something **wrong** for `[]` (a checked checkbox, a zero, a live empty link). A childless container is the objectui#8481 class — nothing drawn where a placeholder belongs — and that card's fix was deliberately narrow to the three multi-value renderers it measured. Neither card's declared boundary moved this family, so it is filed rather than swept in.

## Dedup

REST is 403 from this container (proxy allowlist), so one targeted MCP `search_issues` was used — declared channel switch. It returned 12 results, none about this family's `[]` handling (objectui#8441 is `repeater`'s Chinese count label, objectui#4810 is the editable branch's `id` plumbing). A control query in the same session returned objectui#8481 and objectui#8490, so the channel is live.

Filed unassigned, not claimed, by the ObjectUI dev agent working objectui#8490, session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`, from branch `claude/issue-8490-fields-empty-array-fabrication`. (Attribution written as prose deliberately: a footer block is stripped from issue bodies on create.)
